The '''Zillo Beast incident''' occurred on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After discovering the last known [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] after the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] scientific community and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] both desired to study the beast's invulnerable scales to create impenetrable armor for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. However, they decided to conduct this study on Coruscant, and subsequently transported the heavily-sedated beast to a facility.

[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sionver Boll/Legends|Sionver Boll]], throughout the course of her examination of the beast, found that she couldn't remove the Zillo Beast's scales without harming it, and thus Palpatine ordered her to kill it. During the attempted execution, the beast escaped and rampaged [[Galactic City/Legends|Coruscant City]] until it arrived at the Galactic [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] to avenge itself on the Chancellor. It was unable to, however, and was killed by a bombardment of poisonous gas from a number of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/is]], but not before killing and injuring many [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and civilians.

The next day, the Zillo Beast's carcass was transported on a lift so that further research could be conducted on the body. As she was observing the transport of the body, Dr. Boll, much to her surprise, was ordered by Palpatine to [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] the beast.
